reason: Integrates with DeepSeek APIs and pricing data to show account balance and estimated per-session costs in the DeepSeek Harness web interface.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中显示账户余额、会话估算费用及按模型和代币类型划分的成本明细。
summaries.en: Displays DeepSeek account balance, estimated session cost, and model- and token-level cost details in the DeepSeek Harness web interface.

capabilities: Reads DeepSeek account balance through the configured API endpoint
Fetches official DeepSeek pricing data periodically
Calculates estimated session spend from token usage and model pricing
Displays balance and cost breakdown in the web interface
